resources.string: Add instructions when a tool finishes and its result matches your conditions. Rules stay dormant until an event matches.
New rules are scoped to this chat. This library also shows rules from other chats, assistants and workspaces.

The JADX command finished with a nonzero exit code. Inspect the error before deciding what failed; a nonzero code alone does not prove invalid usage. If the error concerns arguments or options, read the installed jadx --help and check the installed version, then adjust the command to that version. Explain the relevant correction. Do not repeat the same failing command unchanged. Preserve input files; choose a separate output directory and respect existing tool approvals.
The right instruction at the right moment
Try the disabled JADX example, edit its conditions and prompt, then enable and save it. Nothing executes while you edit or preview a rule.
Exact names separated by commas. Leave empty for any tool. Background completion is linked to its original tool.
For example, jadx. Matches a recognized program name, not a full shell parser. Use command text for scripts or complex commands.
Literal text; regular expressions are not used.
All filled conditions must match. Empty conditions do not restrict the rule.
The instruction is added to the next model request. It does not automatically rerun the command or change tool permissions.
No skills installed. Install one in Extensions → Skills, or use a prompt.
This skill is not currently installed. The hook cannot load it until it is available.
Relative .md, .markdown, .txt or .text path. For example, references/jadx.md. Read when the hook fires.
Exact Markdown heading text without #. Leave empty to read the whole file.
All chats are eligible. Subagents still require the separate inheritance switch.
Applies when any selected assistant, workspace or chat matches. Select one or more targets.
Apply parent-scope and Everywhere rules to subagents. A directly selected assistant, workspace or chat always qualifies, including a subagent’s own scope.
1–10. Repeated reads of the same finished background job do not trigger the same rule again.
Test against a past tool call
Shows matching conditions and the resolved instruction without executing a tool or saving this draft.
No matching items are available yet.
Could not load or save hook settings. Your draft is kept; try again.
Delete “%1$s”? This does not remove past firing details from the chat.
The repeat limit must be between 1 and 10.
Use a relative Markdown or text path inside the skill, without .., absolute paths or backslashes.
The name must be no longer than 128 characters.
The instruction must be no longer than 16,000 characters.
Each text condition is limited to 1,024 characters; the executable name to 256.
Use at most 32 tool names, each no longer than 128 characters.
